meta.title: MiniMax H3
meta.description:
MiniMax H3 brings image generation, image editing, text-to-video, first/last-frame video, and reference-to-video into one right-sidebar workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with six agent tools for the same tasks.

New lets you choose an image or video task, fill its own parameters, attach reference images, videos, or audio, preview them as thumbnails or waveforms, and submit. History filters by type or status, shows dates and local cost estimates, opens files, copies paths, retries failed videos with their original source materials, and deletes records with optional media cleanup. Running videos are checked every seven seconds with elapsed time and the last check; automatic checking stops after 30 minutes. Settings covers the MiniMax connection, default models, interface language, local balance, and an alert threshold. Choosing Modify in History inserts the task ID into the composer so the conversation agent can continue with the edit or reference tools.

Image requests are synchronous and non-idempotent, so they are never retried automatically. Video submission and download are separate, so a failed download can be retried without submitting again. Balances and prices are local estimates, not MiniMax's statement, and an ordinary key cannot read the real balance. Prompts and reference media are sent to the configured MiniMax endpoint; generated files, task records, pending references, and settings stay under $DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-minimax-h3. The plugin has no telemetry of its own. The API key is stored in the shared MINIMAX_API_KEY credential; uninstalling keeps credentials, generated files, and task records.
